name: sphinx-docs-sync
description: Compare and synchronize Sphinx documentation against the upstream `kdeldycke/repomatic` reference, or across sibling projects. Downstream repos compare against upstream by default. Find the differences in conf.py, install.md, the index.md toctree, pyproject.toml docs dependencies, extra-deps sections, readme badges and static assets. Use when you align documentation structure, catch stale dependencies, or push improvements across Sphinx-enabled repositories.
